question_pattern: Quantitative causal inquiry examining sleep duration or acute intervention on academic or cognitive performance
rationale: Causal claims examining interventions or physiological exposures on academic performance require randomized experimental or rigorous quasi-experimental designs.
notes: Causal claims with manipulation/intervention require experimental or robust quasi-experimental designs.

question_pattern: Qualitative inquiry into subjective lived experience and belonging of underrepresented student cohorts
rationale: Inquiry into the subjective, nuanced lived experience of social identity and campus belonging requires phenomenological or narrative qualitative traditions.
notes: Inquiry into subjective lived experience aligns with phenomenological and qualitative methodologies.

question_pattern: Mixed methods evaluation addressing simultaneous intervention effectiveness and adoption barriers
rationale: Inquiries simultaneously addressing quantitative effectiveness ('what works') and qualitative adoption drivers ('how/why') require integrated mixed methods.
notes: Simultaneous questions of efficacy (what/how much) and adoption/resistance (why/how) necessitate mixed methods.

question_pattern: Trauma-informed qualitative inquiry exploring coping strategies of domestic violence survivors
rationale: Research with trauma survivors mandates qualitative, trauma-informed, sensitive designs with stringent ethical debriefing and confidentiality safeguards.
notes: Highly sensitive populations require trauma-informed, qualitative, non-exploitative designs with rigorous ethics protocols.

question_pattern: Qualitative ethnographic immersion in workplace or community subcultures
rationale: Deciphering shared meanings, implicit norms, and daily rituals within a community requires sustained ethnographic immersion and participant observation.
notes: Cultural norms and social group practices require ethnographic immersion and observation.

question_pattern: Quantitative correlational or survey investigation of non-manipulated variable relationships
rationale: Investigating naturally occurring associations or predictive relationships across populations without experimental manipulation requires correlational or survey designs.
notes: Examining non-manipulated relationships or predictive associations calls for survey or correlational design.

question_pattern: Grounded theory exploration of process-oriented professional decision-making
rationale: Inductively generating substantive theory from empirical process data requires systematic grounded theory constant comparative methods.
notes: Developing substantive theory from raw process data requires grounded theory methodology.

question_pattern: In-depth case study of an intervention or change within a bounded institutional system
rationale: Investigating complex organizational phenomena in depth within real-life bounded boundaries calls for single or multiple case study methodology.
notes: In-depth investigation of an event or program within a real-life bounded context mandates case study design.

question_pattern: Systematic literature review and quantitative meta-analysis of pooled clinical or educational trials
rationale: Synthesizing secondary quantitative evidence across published trials requires PRISMA-compliant systematic review and meta-analytic modeling.
notes: Synthesizing secondary evidence across existing published trials requires systematic review / meta-analysis.

question_pattern: Longitudinal prospective cohort study tracking exposures over time into health outcomes
rationale: Evaluating the temporal progression of risk exposures to chronic disease over decades requires prospective observational cohort designs.
notes: Tracking prospective exposure-outcome sequences over time requires longitudinal cohort designs.

question_pattern: Quasi-experimental policy evaluation using difference-in-differences or interrupted time series
rationale: Evaluating macro policy changes across jurisdictions where randomization is impossible necessitates econometric quasi-experiments.
notes: Macro policy and legislative interventions require difference-in-differences or interrupted time series designs.

question_pattern: Laboratory experiment with factorial manipulation of sensory or cognitive load conditions
rationale: Isolating sensory and cognitive mechanism interactions requires tightly controlled factorial laboratory experiments.
notes: Multifactor cognitive mechanism isolation requires controlled factorial laboratory experiments.

question_pattern: Qualitative narrative inquiry examining biographical life histories and professional trajectories
rationale: Exploring individual historical and professional journeys requires narrative inquiry and chronological life history analysis.
notes: Capturing individual longitudinal life journeys requires narrative inquiry.

question_pattern: Implementation science evaluation of community health intervention reach, fidelity, and sustainability
rationale: Assessing intervention delivery, adherence, and organizational translation requires implementation science frameworks (e.g., RE-AIM).
notes: Healthcare implementation and translational rollouts require implementation science hybrid designs.

question_pattern: AI and machine learning empirical diagnostic performance benchmark vs clinical experts
rationale: Evaluating clinical AI model diagnostics against human physicians requires rigorous benchmark diagnostic test accuracy standards.
notes: AI/ML algorithm diagnostic evaluations mandate formal diagnostic test accuracy methodologies.

question_pattern: Human-AI interaction and software engineering mixed methods usability evaluation
acceptable_analysis: paired t-test on task completion times
rationale: Assessing human-AI collaboration tools requires measuring objective performance metrics alongside subjective cognitive workload.
notes: Human-AI tool evaluation necessitates mixed methods combining task telemetry with user cognitive experience.

question_pattern: Educational design-based research (DBR) testing iterative curriculum or digital learning artifacts
rationale: Refining innovative pedagogical technology artifacts through continuous classroom iterations requires design-based research.
notes: Iterative educational technology development within classrooms aligns with design-based research.

question_pattern: Phase III double-blind randomized clinical trial evaluating medical pharmacological efficacy
rationale: Establishing regulatory-grade therapeutic drug efficacy and safety profiles requires double-blind randomized clinical trials.
notes: Therapeutic medical interventions mandate double-blind randomized clinical trial methodologies.

question_pattern: Sensitive qualitative inquiry exploring suicidal ideation and crisis recovery among adolescent patients
rationale: Understanding crisis and recovery narratives in vulnerable adolescent psychiatric cohorts mandates sensitive qualitative phenomenological inquiry with ethical distress protocols.
notes: Acute psychiatric patient investigations require specialized clinical qualitative methods and safety monitoring.

question_pattern: Quantitative psychometric instrument development and structural equation validation
rationale: Creating and validating psychological measurement instruments demands multi-stage psychometric development (EFA/CFA/SEM).
notes: Measurement scale creation demands psychometric factor analysis and structural equation validation.

question_pattern: Exploratory sequential mixed methods developing survey metrics from indigenous oral histories
rationale: Translating localized cultural and community knowledge into standardized survey metrics requires exploratory sequential mixed methods.
notes: Qualitative-first instrument design from grounded community insights necessitates exploratory sequential mixed methods.

question_pattern: Comparative historical analysis of social institutions across nation-states
acceptable_analysis: qualitative comparative analysis crisp-set or fuzzy-set
rationale: Explaining long-term macro-institutional divergence across countries requires comparative historical analysis and process tracing.
notes: Macro cross-national institutional policy divergences call for comparative historical analysis.

question_pattern: Empirical software engineering artifact repository analysis of automated static tools
acceptable_designs: interrupted time series on repository commits
acceptable_analysis: negative binomial regression on defect counts
survival analysis on pull request duration
rationale: Investigating code quality and review latency across repositories requires empirical mining of software repositories (MSR).
notes: Evaluating developer artifacts across open-source code repositories requires mining software repositories techniques.

question_pattern: Epidemiological case-control study investigating rare environmental exposures and disease onset
acceptable_analysis: odds ratio calculations with 95% confidence intervals
rationale: Evaluating rare or latent disease associations with environmental contaminants efficiently requires matched case-control designs.
notes: Rare clinical health outcomes and environmental exposures call for retrospective case-control designs.

question_pattern: Qualitative critical discourse analysis of media framing regarding climate migration
rationale: Deconstructing institutional power relations and ideological framing in journalistic media mandates critical discourse analysis.
notes: Uncovering power dynamics and framing in public textual records requires critical discourse analysis.

question_pattern: Participatory action research collaborating with frontline healthcare workers on protocol redesign
rationale: Empowering practitioners to co-investigate and transform their daily workplace protocols requires participatory action research cycles.
notes: Democratized organizational problem-solving with practitioner stakeholders necessitates participatory action research.
